reviewFindings.summary: matrix lane evidence claimed aggregate fixtures that the individual lane did not execute
reviewFindings.correction: record aggregate scenario membership separately from a validated executed-fixture subset and lane-specific oracle

reviewFindings.summary: pull-request merge SHA was mislabeled as the source SHA
reviewFindings.correction: record PR head, checkout merge, and workflow provenance SHAs separately

reviewFindings.summary: hosted writer did not fail closed on self-hosted, missing image metadata, or non-NTFS execution
reviewFindings.correction: require GitHub-hosted Windows X64 image metadata, OS build, and NTFS before hosted evidence can pass

reviewFindings.summary: evidence source binding accepted any matching 40-hex values without ancestry or post-source path enforcement
reviewFindings.correction: require a resolvable P4-descended source commit and evidence-only successor changes with manifest, ledger, and baseline equality

reviewFindings.summary: the claimed final full-regression pass predated the bound final source revision
reviewFindings.correction: retain the earlier-source failure and execute the complete suite once at the final bound source revision

reviewFindings.summary: blocking jobs wrote sanitized evidence only on success and could lose an executed failure
reviewFindings.correction: run finalizers on every non-cancelled outcome and label GitHub job-status normalization separately from a direct process exit

reviewFindings.summary: exact P5 allowlist entries accepted suffix lookalikes through prefix matching
reviewFindings.correction: distinguish exact file entries from directory prefixes and add a negative suffix-lookalike test

reviewFindings.summary: profile coverage, scenario ownership, timeout equality, early Node identity, and gate result aggregation were under-validated
reviewFindings.correction: require one-to-one test and blocking-profile mappings, exact timeouts, Node identity before use, and exact needs/result bindings

reviewFindings.summary: the evidence writer could emit an executed pass for a blocked profile without a workflow job
reviewFindings.correction: forbid runner evidence for unimplemented profiles and require the exact declared workflow job for implemented profiles

reviewFindings.summary: the Windows resource oracle delegated to a taskkill call without an internal time bound
reviewFindings.correction: invoke the exact taskkill executable and PID tree arguments through a five-second bounded child process

reviewFindings.summary: attempt ledger and artifact digest shapes did not fully enforce ordered execution truth
reviewFindings.correction: validate exact keys, contiguous ordinals, unique identities, outcome consistency, privacy, and null-or-SHA-256 artifact identity

reviewFindings.summary: the no-artifact claim omitted dependency-review's conditional large-summary artifact
reviewFindings.correction: limit the claim to repository-authored uploads and record the exact one-megabyte threshold, one-day retention, and non-trust role

reviewFindings.summary: new CI and P5 evidence surfaces had no repository ownership entries
reviewFindings.correction: add exact CODEOWNERS entries while retaining that remote enforcement and administrator policy were only read, not changed

reviewFindings.summary: some inherited runtime tests contain conditional early returns that reduce their individual oracle strength
reviewFindings.correction: do not claim exhaustive lifecycle coverage; retain this inherited limitation because P5 does not change protected product or inherited test behavior

reviewFindings.summary: dependency review was asserted to fail deterministically because the repository is a fork
reviewFindings.correction: keep the hosted job blocking and NOT-RUN because authenticated read-only dependency comparison succeeded and no deterministic hosted failure was reproduced

reviewFindings.summary: the hardened digest schema used a standard keyword unsupported by the repository's restricted validator
reviewFindings.correction: encode the same null-or-exact-SHA-256 constraint with the supported type array and retain the failed validation attempt

reviewFindings.summary: the workflow validator allowed the only P4 targeted-contract lane flag to be changed to false
reviewFindings.correction: require exact current true and previous false lane values plus the exact matrix-conditioned P4 test step, with a negative mutation test

reviewFindings.summary: setup or exact-Node failure could prevent the non-cancelled failure finalizer from producing structured evidence
reviewFindings.correction: start the clock immediately after checkout, allow failure-only nullable Node readback with an explicit identity status, and retain exact Node as mandatory for every pass

reviewFindings.summary: the workflow validator accepted a no-op in place of the exact P4 targeted command when the test path string remained
reviewFindings.correction: bind the current lane to the exact single-line node test command and reject command replacement, chaining, or appended success with negative mutation tests

reviewFindings.summary: a block-scalar no-op could satisfy the exact-command regex by embedding a decoy step sequence inside inert PowerShell text
reviewFindings.correction: require one unique inline command step at exact YAML job-step indentation and retain a block-scalar here-string negative mutation
